day_open_schedule.title: Day opens (cron)
day_open_schedule.description: When the morning anchor runs. Five-field cron, in the machine's local time.

nudge_budget_per_day.title: Unrequested messages per day
nudge_budget_per_day.description: The ceiling outside the anchors. Lower is usually better. Declaring this switches the interruption budget on.

quiet_hours.title: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.description: No unrequested messages in this window. Replies are never held back.

nudge_project_cooldown_minutes.title: Minimum gap per project (minutes)
nudge_project_cooldown_minutes.description: Three separate thoughts about the same project in one hour is one interruption too many.

nudge_kind_cooldown_minutes.title: Minimum gap per kind (minutes)
nudge_kind_cooldown_minutes.description: Stops one repeating condition from filling the day's budget on its own.

watch_schedule.title: Watch runs (cron)
watch_schedule.description: How often to sweep for things worth noticing between the anchors. Cheap: with nothing to report it never wakes the model.

calendar_command.title: Calendar command (optional)
calendar_command.description: Shell command that prints today's agenda. Its output reaches the morning anchor already fetched, so reading it costs no tool call and no permission. Blank means no calendar, and the anchor simply says nothing about one. Example: apx mcp run calendar list_events '{"timeMin":"today"}'

stale_project_days.title: A project is stale after (days)
stale_project_days.description: Days without recorded task or commitment activity before it is worth mentioning.

blocked_task_hours.title: A blocked task is stuck after (hours)
blocked_task_hours.description: Blocked this morning is a normal working state, not a problem.

commitment_lead_hours.title: Warn about a promise this early (hours)
commitment_lead_hours.description: How far ahead of its date to raise a commitment, while there is still time to keep it.

primary_channel.title: Primary channel
primary_channel.description: Where unrequested messages go by default.

routine_delivery.title: Where the anchors are delivered
routine_delivery.description: The morning and evening messages are handed to this channel by the runtime, so they arrive whether or not the model remembers to send them. 'none' keeps them in the log only.

formality.title: Form of address
formality.description: Only meaningful in languages that distinguish it.
